# Zifan Chen

Corporate Banking Associate | M.S. in Applied Business Analytics Candidate | Financial Research & Strategy

Welcome to my professional portfolio website.

I am currently a Corporate Banking Associate at Bank of China (Toronto Branch) and a Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics candidate at Boston University. My background combines corporate banking, cross-border finance, credit analysis, and macroeconomic research.

This website presents my professional profile, selected research and project experience, curriculum vitae, and contact information.

## Core Areas of Focus

- Corporate Banking and Relationship Management  
- Credit Analysis and Syndicated Lending  
- Cross-border Trade and Financial Services  
- Economic Research and Policy Analysis  

## Professional Profile

With experience spanning client service, corporate banking, and policy-oriented financial research, I aim to build a career in corporate banking, investment banking, and broader financial strategy roles. My work focuses on connecting market developments and economic policy with practical business and credit decisions.
